name: Цельная глыба — монолитный гребень
subject: ONE destructible natural gray rock resource asset, angular stepped fused voxel geology, warm-gray primary stone with a few pale coarse mineral patches, dark-gray wide fracture seams and restrained FLAT olive moss color patches attached to stone surfaces (no growing plants). Large Minecraft-style cubic masses with chunky material pixels, no tiny rubble confetti, smooth beveled stone or photoreal texture. No soil, ground, grass, pedestal or landscape. This is ONE variant, not a family gallery or destruction sequence. All five copies show the same arrangement of main masses, cracks and separate fragments. INTACT first-stage large boulder. A tall thick central rectangular monolith ridge, uneven stepped top, two substantial lower buttress stone shoulders at its base; mass mostly continuous, pronounced vertical seam on one side. No scattered destruction pile.
caption: Один вариант соответствующей стадии разрушения: пять ракурсов без земли, ландшафта и подписи.
